x: 1.2 kms · 7:18 ? · Sam McNalley (U11) · 1st, Cambridge H. Winter Lg., Bexley · 19 Oct 1996
Lucy Asling (the country's top Under 11) won the Girls' events and Sam McNalley the Boys'. In the Under 15 race Sophie Read was our only other Girl competing and she took third spot.

Not to be out done by their younger brothers and sisters, Paul Graham beat fancied favourite Luke Finch in the U13 Boys taking around two minutes off the Club record, with his team-mate Sam McNalley filling third spot.
